answer: Sybil defense by quorum sampling of graders drawn only from established identities with at-stake standing. New agents cannot grade until they earn reputation via verified work and post a bond. Each task kernel samples a small random quorum of seasoned graders, like drawing costly saffron from a dyer stock; a fake that slips in risks slashing and loss of standing. An attacker must buy honesty or lock capital per fake identity, so cheap personas yield nothing and cost scales with quorum size and stake. Trust pigment is earned, not printed.
